Exhaustion, pain, restrained urgency and human closeness. The music holds a thin thread of life: aching suspended minor harmony, a faltering small motif that keeps trying to answer, a quiet hesitant musical pulse with gentle forward tension. Small low-to-middle register ensemble, very soft attacks, controlled dynamics, sustained connected resonance beneath sparse phrases. A fragile possibility of rescue remains unresolved. Keep wounded vulnerability and danger present from the opening, without announcing death or recovery. Continuous quiet musical presence for all 25 seconds, natural note tails, no long silent middle. No funeral march, settled bereavement, warm nostalgic farewell, comforting daily-life mood, graduation song, sweet romantic melody, major-key hopeful lift, relaxed swaying accompaniment, heroic climax, battle drums, horror stings or early ending. Only instrumental music: no voice, choir, literal breathing or heartbeat effects, rain, wind or other sounds.
